content: Live stats data sources on Linux (nvtop/btop/fastfetch pattern, from tool docs/knowledge): CPU per-core load+freq from /proc/stat + /sys/devices/system/cpu/*/cpufreq/scaling_cur_freq; temps via hwmon (k10temp/zenpower AMD, coretemp Intel) and sensors; CPU package power via Intel/AMD RAPL powercap (/sys/class/powercap/intel-rapl:*/energy_uj, AMD via amd_hsmp or rapl); NVIDIA GPU util/VRAM/power/temp via NVML (nvidia-smi); AMD GPU via amdgpu sysfs (/sys/class/drm/card*/device/{gpu_busy_percent,hwmon*/avg_power_power1?} = device/energy or hwmon 'power1_average'); Intel iGPU weakest (no standard power). Vendor detection is a hard prerequisite for the power/VRAM columns; degrade gracefully per-metric.
